title: Office After Hours [Native animation 2]
description: 10 offices. Touch blue door buttons and drawer handles. Hold physical gems for immunity; release to lose protection. 60s calm / 60s hunt; key after five hunts. Dead players use a spectator balcony. Experimental: Quest validation required.

levelNodeSign.text:
AFTER HOURS
SURVIVE FIVE HUNTS — 10 PLAYERS

Touch blue door buttons and drawer handles.
Touch blue pads to hide / leave. One player per spot.
HOLD a gem for immunity. Dropping it removes protection.
After five hunts: find the key and touch the exit lock.
DEAD players watch from the enclosed balcony.

SPECTATOR — ELIMINATED
Watch the surviving players below.
